svg.data-weight-note: Guide Table 7: chassis with backplane 89 lb (41 kg), base configuration 149 lb (68 kg), redundant 187 lb (85 kg), fully loaded 284 lb (129 kg), the last with the heaviest line cards in all eight slots. The datasheet gives 115 lb (52.5 kg), 176 lb (80 kg), 216 lb (98 kg) and 328 lb (149 kg); the guide's table is carried (gap weights).
svg.data-switching-capacity: up to 6.2 Tbps (datasheet and guide, "Benefits of the EX8208 Switch")
